headline.text: L3 Matrix pouches ran with *wrong lot code* for unknown duration — piece code used instead of date code.

summary: One traceability gap at L3 Matrix, one contamination-exposure event at L3 ML4 (tote scrap instructed), and one metal-detector operational issue at L1 S2 (nuisance rejects, not detection failure).

food_safety.title: S2 metal detector nuisance rejects — salt blower interference
food_safety.summary: Metal detector read test cards correctly but opened constantly during production; Caleb York adjusted salt blower air valve to resolve.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — air valve partially closed, detector functioning correctly after adjustment.

food_safety.title: Punctured chocolate tote — exposed product
food_safety.summary: Angel Cabrera flagged a new tote with punctured liner exposing the bottom chocolate layer; instructed third shift to scrap the exposed portion when reached.
food_safety.status: Resolved on shift — scrap instruction issued, no confirmation of completion in window.

quality.title: ML4 gondola sync failures — repeated broken bars
quality.summary: Gondola belt repeatedly jammed and became unsynced with infeed conveyor, breaking bars throughout third shift; maintenance troubleshot 04:47–06:48.
quality.status: Investigation ongoing — Kavin Ayala and Nelson Cook still troubleshooting at window close (06:48).

quality.title: ML4 depositor mass-supply alarm bypassed
quality.summary: Depositor 1 mass supply A minimum value found set to 0%, allowing hopper to run empty without fault; Shawn Jewkes flagged, corrected to 10%.
quality.status: Resolved — QA reset value to 10% and confirmed with team.

quality.title: Grinding scrap not logged in safety chain
quality.summary: Haydee Hidalgo flagged that scrap was not reported in safety chain, no details on quantity or root cause.
quality.status: Open — management notified, no resolution confirmed.

allergen.title: Matrix pouches printed with incorrect lot code
allergen.summary: Matrix line ran pouches with piece lot code instead of current date lot code; Nathan Gevenois confirmed error at 04:05, unknown run duration or quantity affected.
allergen.status: Open — error confirmed by supervisor, no disposition or hold action documented in window.

opportunities.text: Review S2 metal-detector checklist to include salt-blower air-valve position — today's nuisance rejects resolved by valve adjustment, suggesting drift over time.
Consider adding lot-code verification to Matrix startup checklist — today's wrong-code event ran for unknown duration before QA caught it.
Review ML4 gondola preventive maintenance schedule — repeated belt-sync failures and jams echo chronic issues flagged earlier this month.
